title: Grand Exchange Art Floor
description: A bustling indoor art market scene set in a grand classical hall with marble columns and arched windows. Numerous people in early 20th century attire browse and trade paintings, sculptures, and prints at stalls under signs reading 'Grand Exchange - Art Floor'.
prompt: A detailed realistic painting of a busy indoor art fair inside a grand classical hall with high arched windows and marble pillars. Early 20th century men and women in period clothing browse stalls covered with green cloth, examining paintings of birds, sculptures, and rolled prints. Signs overhead read 'Grand Exchange - Art Floor'. People are conversing, writing notes, and holding artwork while a lively crowd fills the space.
